fields.description: What this effect does when its Step node runs. The same verb set the automation engine uses, minus Wait (a workflow parks at a Wait node, never inside an Action Group). A Step runs only effect-lane verbs; guard verbs are ignored here. Effects run top-to-bottom inside one savepoint.
fields.label: Action Type
fields.options:
Require Fields
Require Location
Create Task
Update Field
Append Child Row
Upsert Child Row
Call Webhook
Create Note
Send WhatsApp
Send Email

fields.description: How the new task's due date is resolved. From Context = read the Due From Field from workflow state. Expression = evaluate a Python expression (safe_eval) against ctx.
fields.label: Due Mode

fields.description: State key whose datetime value becomes the new task's due date. Blank = a default lead time.
fields.label: Due From Field

fields.description: Python expression evaluated against ctx (safe_eval) for the new task's due date - e.g. add_days(ctx['custom_dob'], 7).
fields.label: Due Expression

fields.description: The activity type to raise as an open task when this Step runs.
fields.label: Task Type

fields.description: DocType the field is written to (e.g. CRM Lead). Must be in the Automatable-Field allowlist for this grain.
fields.label: Target DocType

fields.description: The fieldname to set on the target doctype.
fields.label: Fieldname

fields.description: Literal = use the Value as-is. From Context = read the named state key. Expression = evaluate a Python expression (safe_eval) against ctx.
fields.label: Value Mode

fields.description: The literal value to write.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: State key whose value is written.
fields.label: Context Field

fields.description: Python expression evaluated against ctx (safe_eval) - e.g. add_days(ctx['custom_dob'], 3).
fields.label: Expression

fields.description: CRM Lead child-table fieldname to write into, e.g. custom_lab_profile.
fields.label: Child Table

fields.description: JSON {child_fieldname: value} identifying the row to update; blank match appends a new row.
fields.label: Match (JSON)

fields.description: JSON {child_fieldname: value} to set on the row. Each key must be in the allowlist for this grain. Use "$ctx.<field>" to pull from workflow state; otherwise the value is literal.
fields.label: Set (JSON)

fields.description: The configured outbound endpoint to call (native Webhook, delivery-only). Admin-curated; the Step only picks it.
fields.label: Webhook Endpoint

fields.description: What rides the webhook body. Lead = the workflow's subject Lead (default). Trigger Doc = the subject record itself; in a workflow Step these resolve to the same subject doc.
fields.label: Webhook Payload Source

fields.description: Literal = use the Comment Text as-is. Expression = evaluate a Python expression (safe_eval) against ctx (must yield a string).
fields.label: Comment Mode

fields.description: The comment text to add to the workflow's subject record.
fields.label: Comment Text

fields.description: Python expression (safe_eval) that must yield a string, e.g. f'stage: {ctx["stage"]}'.
fields.label: Comment Expression

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fieldnames on the subject that must be set - a guard verb (not run by a Step; kept for field-set parity with the automation action).
fields.label: Require Fields

fields.description: Optional geofence radius in meters for the Require Location guard - a guard verb (not run by a Step; kept for field-set parity).
fields.label: Geofence Meters

fields.description: The WATI template to send (grain-routed). Dormant unless Task::Automation::sends is on.
fields.label: WhatsApp Template

fields.description: Refresh every WATI account's template catalog, then pick above.
fields.label: Sync Templates

fields.description: Recipient email address for the Send Email effect.
fields.label: Email Recipient

fields.description: Subject line for the Send Email effect.
fields.label: Email Subject

fields.description: Body for the Send Email effect.
fields.label: Email Body
